headline: Expiry‑day trading is costing you money.

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: The expiry‑day trades cost you ₹1,16,891. In the 90 expiry‑day trades you saw a loss of ₹1,16,891, an average loss of ₹1,299, a win rate of 29% and a 28% loss on average. The remaining 124 trades showed a 5% loss on average, a loss of ₹449 per trade and a win rate of 37%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: You might want to apply this rule in the coming month.
